name: Solas Women's Health

primary.note: the logo. Coral mark, ink wordmark. Cream, white or light photography.

primary-deep.note: same structure, deep rose mark. Use below 160px or on a busy background.

reversed.note: dark backgrounds. Coral mark kept, wordmark white, subline peach.

onecolour-white.note: single-colour reverse where coral cannot be used.

palette.name: Coral (primary)
palette.use: The mark. Brand signature, fills, large fields.

palette.name: Deep rose
palette.use: The mark at small sizes; buttons and links.

clearSpace: Keep free space around the logo equal to the diameter of the centre dot in the mark on every side.
minSizeNote: Below the stacked minimum, drop the subline and use mark + wordmark. Below the mark minimum, use the mark alone — never shrink the full lockup further.
do: Place the supplied artwork; scale proportionally
Switch to primary-deep whenever the logo gets small
Use reversed on dark or photographic fields
Give the logo more room than you think it needs
dont: Retype the wordmark — always place the artwork
Make the wordmark coral, or the mark ink
Recolour, add gradients, shadows, outlines or effects
Stretch, rotate, skew or rearrange the lockup
Use the coral mark on white below 160px

fonts.note: the SOLAS wordmark and all display/headings. Regular (400).
the WOMEN'S HEALTH subline and all body copy. Subline is 800.
